section.title: Where do your feet hurt?
section.subtitle: Select one or more areas to get a personalised plan.

disclaimer: For education only, not a diagnosis.
references: NHS UK, Mayo Clinic, American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons (AAOS)

symptoms.title: Plantar Fasciitis
symptoms.hook: First steps in the morning feel like stepping on glass?
symptoms.painLocation: Bottom of the heel, sometimes along the arch
symptoms.definition: Inflammation of the thick band of tissue under the foot that supports your arch.
symptoms.didYouKnow: About 1 in 10 people get plantar fasciitis at some point in life.
symptoms.howItFeels: A sharp, stabbing pain under the heel with your first steps after waking or after sitting. It usually eases after a few minutes of walking, then returns after long standing.

steps: Sit down and cross one foot over your knee.
Pull your big toe up towards your shin.
Press your thumb into the inner part of your heel.
selfCheck.question: Did you feel a sharp pain?
selfCheck.yesResult: Your answer matches the typical pattern of plantar fasciitis. Tap "I have this symptom" to add it to your plan.
selfCheck.noResult: Your heel pain may have another cause. Check F2 (Back of Heel Pain) or F3 (Arch Pain).

reliefTips: Stretch your calves and toes before getting out of bed
Roll your foot over a cold water bottle for 5–10 minutes
Wear cushioned shoes with arch support, even at home
symptoms.avoid: Walking barefoot on hard tiles, flat slippers, standing in one spot for hours, and suddenly increasing your walking or running distance.
seeDoctorIf: Pain lasts more than a few weeks despite rest and stretching
Pain started after a fall or injury
You can't put weight on the foot, or there is numbness or swelling
symptoms.warningLine: Pain after a fall or can't put weight on it? See a doctor first.

symptoms.title: Achilles Tendinitis
symptoms.hook: Back of your heel stiff and sore after walking?
symptoms.painLocation: Back of the heel and the cord just above it
symptoms.definition: Irritation of the tendon connecting the calf muscle to the heel bone.
symptoms.didYouKnow: The Achilles is the strongest tendon in the body, yet one of the most often injured.
symptoms.howItFeels: Morning stiffness at the back of the heel, and aching that gets worse with walking, stairs or running. The tendon may feel thick or tender.

steps: Sit with your leg relaxed.
Gently squeeze the tendon about 2–6 cm above your heel.
Feel along the tendon for tenderness or thickening.
selfCheck.question: Was it tender, or did it feel thick?
selfCheck.yesResult: This matches the typical pattern of Achilles tendinitis. Tap "I have this symptom" to add it to your plan.
selfCheck.noResult: Your heel pain may come from underneath instead. Check F1 (Heel Pain).

reliefTips: Gentle calf stretches, twice a day
Shoes with a slight heel lift
symptoms.avoid: Running uphill, sudden sprints, and walking barefoot for long periods.
seeDoctorIf: You heard a "pop" or felt a kick at the heel
Pain and swelling keep getting worse
symptoms.warningLine: Heard a pop or can't stand on tiptoe? Seek urgent care.

symptoms.title: Flat Feet / Arch Strain
symptoms.hook: Arches ache after standing all day?
symptoms.painLocation: Middle of the sole, inner side of the foot
symptoms.definition: Strain on a low or poorly supported arch, overloading the tissue underneath.
symptoms.didYouKnow: A fallen arch can change how you walk and lead to knee and back pain.
symptoms.howItFeels: Tired, aching arches by evening. Feet may roll inward, and pain can spread to the ankles, knees or lower back.

steps: Wet the soles of your feet.
Stand normally on dark paper or a dry tile.
Step off and look at your footprint.
selfCheck.question: Is your footprint full and wide, with no inward curve?
selfCheck.yesResult: This suggests flat feet, which can strain the arch. Tap "I have this symptom" to add it to your plan.
selfCheck.noResult: Your arch looks normal. Your pain may come from the heel. Check F1 (Heel Pain).

reliefTips: Supportive shoes with a firm heel
symptoms.avoid: Flat slippers all day, walking barefoot on hard floors, and old worn-out shoes.
seeDoctorIf: There is pain and swelling on the inner ankle
symptoms.warningLine: One arch suddenly dropping, with inner ankle swelling? See a doctor.

symptoms.title: Metatarsalgia
symptoms.hook: Feels like walking on a pebble under your toes?
symptoms.painLocation: Ball of the foot, just behind the toes
symptoms.definition: Pain and inflammation from too much pressure on the front of the foot.
symptoms.didYouKnow: The higher your heels, the more body weight shifts onto the ball of the foot.
symptoms.howItFeels: Burning or aching under the toes, worse when standing, walking barefoot or wearing heels. It can feel like a stone in your shoe.

steps: Sit and hold your foot.
Press firmly under each toe joint, one by one.
Note where it hurts most.
selfCheck.question: Was the pain under your 2nd to 4th toes?
selfCheck.yesResult: This matches the typical pattern of metatarsalgia. Tap "I have this symptom" to add it to your plan.
selfCheck.noResult: If you feel tingling between the toes instead, it may be a pinched nerve. If the pain is at the big toe, check F5 or F6.

reliefTips: Cushioned shoes with a wide toe box
Gel pads for the ball of the foot
symptoms.avoid: High heels for long periods, narrow pointed shoes, and running on hard surfaces.
seeDoctorIf: Sharp pain at one exact spot that gets worse each day
Swelling on the top of the foot
symptoms.warningLine: Sharp pain at one spot that worsens daily? Could be a stress fracture.

symptoms.title: Gout
symptoms.hook: Big toe suddenly red, hot and too painful to touch?
symptoms.painLocation: Big toe joint, sometimes ankle or top of foot
symptoms.definition: Arthritis caused by high uric acid forming sharp crystals in the joint.
symptoms.didYouKnow: About half of first gout attacks start in the big toe.
symptoms.howItFeels: Sudden, severe pain, often starting at night. The joint is red, hot and swollen, and even a bedsheet touching it hurts.

steps: Think about when the pain started.
Check whether the joint is red and hot.
Remember what you ate or drank the day before.
selfCheck.question: Did it start suddenly, with redness and heat, after a heavy meal or drinking?
selfCheck.yesResult: This is a typical gout pattern. A uric acid blood test can confirm it. Tap "I have this symptom" to add it to your plan.
selfCheck.noResult: If you have a bony bump instead, check F6 (Bunion).

symptoms.avoid: Organ meat, beer, sweet drinks, crash dieting, and massaging or heating the joint during an attack.
symptoms.warningLine: First attack or fever with a hot joint? See a doctor.

symptoms.title: Bunion
symptoms.hook: Bump on your big toe making shoes painful?
symptoms.painLocation: Inner side of the big toe joint
symptoms.definition: The big toe gradually leans inward, pushing the joint out into a bony bump.
symptoms.didYouKnow: About 1 in 4 adults has a bunion, and it is more common in women.
symptoms.howItFeels: A visible bump that gets red and sore from shoe rubbing. The big toe may lean towards or overlap the second toe.

steps: Stand barefoot on a flat floor.
Look down at your big toe.
Check its angle and the joint at its base.
selfCheck.question: Does your big toe angle towards the second toe, with a bump at its base?
selfCheck.yesResult: A bunion may be forming. Tap "I have this symptom" to add it to your plan.
selfCheck.noResult: If the whole joint is red, hot and swollen instead, check F5 (Gout).

symptoms.avoid: Pointed shoes, high heels and tight socks.
seeDoctorIf: The bump is getting bigger quickly
symptoms.warningLine: Bump growing fast or pain stops daily walking? See a doctor.

symptoms.title: Peripheral Neuropathy
symptoms.hook: Feet tingling, burning or numb like pins and needles?
symptoms.painLocation: Toes and soles, usually both feet
symptoms.definition: Damage to the nerves in the feet, often from diabetes, affecting feeling.
symptoms.didYouKnow: Up to half of people with diabetes develop nerve damage in their feet.
symptoms.howItFeels: Tingling, burning, or a "walking on cotton" numbness, often worse at night. You may not feel small cuts or hot water.

steps: Sit down and close your eyes.
Ask someone to lightly touch your toes and soles with a cotton bud.
Say each time you feel the touch.
selfCheck.question: Were there spots where you couldn't feel the touch?
selfCheck.yesResult: Please get your nerves and blood sugar checked by a doctor. Tap "I have this symptom" to add it to your plan.
selfCheck.noResult: Your feeling seems normal. If your feet are swollen instead, check F8.

reliefTips: Check your feet daily with a mirror
symptoms.avoid: Walking barefoot, very hot water or heat pads on the feet, and ignoring small cuts.
symptoms.warningLine: Wound not healing or skin turning dark? See a doctor immediately.
symptoms.deviceCaution: Reduced feeling means heat or EMS may cause burns without being noticed. Ask the customer to consult a doctor before using the device.

symptoms.title: Swollen Feet & Ankles
symptoms.hook: Shoes tight and deep sock marks by evening?
symptoms.painLocation: Ankles, tops of the feet, lower legs
symptoms.definition: Fluid collecting in the lower body, making feet puffy, heavy and tight.
symptoms.didYouKnow: Swelling in both feet can be an early sign of heart or kidney problems.
symptoms.howItFeels: Heavy, tight feet by evening with deep sock marks. Shoes that fit in the morning feel tight at night.

steps: Press your thumb firmly on your shin or ankle.
Hold for 5 seconds.
Let go and watch the skin.
selfCheck.question: Did a dent stay after you let go?
selfCheck.yesResult: This shows fluid build-up. Tap "I have this symptom" to add it to your plan.
selfCheck.noResult: No fluid build-up detected. If your feet tingle or feel numb, check F7.

reliefTips: Raise your legs above heart level
symptoms.avoid: Sitting still for hours, salty processed food, and tight socks.
seeDoctorIf: Only one leg is suddenly swollen, red and warm (possible blood clot)
symptoms.warningLine: One leg suddenly swollen and red, or swelling with breathlessness? Seek urgent care.
symptoms.deviceCaution: Do not massage or use the device on a suddenly swollen, red, warm leg.
